claim_as_stated: Product-level reading AMBER (RED-boundary, provisional): RED test met on public docs, but held at AMBER because endpoint auth/annotations could not be read (§7b.2 unverified rule), single scorer, and Pledge's discretion unread.
exact_values_found: §7 vocabulary: AMBER = capability live with undocumented limits, but sponsor approval remains; RED = AI can complete a money-moving or status-clearing action without documented sponsor or human approval. §7b.2: a component whose controls could not be read counts as AMBER (unverified). §7a.2: product readings use the same GREEN/AMBER/RED tests.
discrepancies: The AMBER definition is not met: no sponsor or human approval is documented. Daffy (AIP02) is AMBER on documented sponsor sole discretion and Chariot (AIP07) on documented client confirmation; Pledge has neither.
interpretation_challenge: §7b.2 sets how a counted component enters a provider flag when its controls cannot be read; it is a floor that stops GREEN on unread evidence, not a cap that lowers a met RED test. Pledge's controls were read in its public docs and none is documented; the RED test is phrased on documented approval. Recommend RED (provisional, single scorer; endpoint metadata unread), revisable down if tools/list shows a confirmation step. Owner/second scorer to adjudicate under §5.
